summary: Add an unwired web sidebar membership paging reducer and read adapter with complete-set publication and bounded frontier resets.

replay.detail: The new reducer is not connected to runtime state or stored data.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Existing web behavior and wire requests are unchanged; the unwired adapter refuses missing authoritative membership epochs.

manual.detail: No upgrade steps required; activation awaits the authoritative membership read contract.

recovery.detail: Revert the unwired module and tests; no persisted state or active behavior requires rollback.
